rules.statement: A plaintiff must obtain probate or letters of administration for an estate exceeding Rs. 1,000 in value before maintaining an action to recover property included in that estate.
rules.supporting_quote: "That section is imperative, and before a plaintiff can maintain an action for the recovery of any property in Ceylon he must comply with the provisions of that section."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 547 of the Civil Procedure Code
